execution: 4 Docker workers, one per GPU process, batch=16 each
notes: Dataset sharded into 4 equal parts (31297 / 31297 / 31297 / 31299 rows).
Shards 0 and 3 contained only benign labels in their row slice — ROC-AUC not meaningful on those shards.
Combined throughput estimated as sum of per-worker rates (98.8 + 100.5 + 98.8 + 98.8 = ~397 samples/s); wall-clock limited by slowest worker (~317s).
ROC-AUC of 0.854 and 0.888 on shards 1 and 2 respectively are shard-local and not directly comparable to full-dataset AUC.
